scope: S3R design review of specs/041-list-filters-from-a-filterset (plan.md, research.md, tasks.md, sketch.md, decisions.md) against the approved spec.md, at worktree HEAD d87cbd0. All three lenses ran. The lens is in each finding's id prefix: SPEC = spec-compliance, SEC = security, ARCH = architecture. Code read: mvp/views/list.py, mvp/filters.py, mvp/integrations/django_tables/views.py, mvp/integrations/django_filters/views.py, mvp/templates/list_view.html, table_view.html, delete_view.html, cotton/mvp/modal.html, cotton/mvp/card/index.html, cotton/mvp/page/list/filters/{field,modal}.html, mvp/checks.py, pyproject.toml, demo/views.py, demo/urls.py, docs/integrations.md, docs/views.md, and the tests in tests/test_views/test_list.py, tests/test_integrations.py and tests/test_table_layout.py. COUNTS: FR against tasks: 28 of 28 traced to a task, 22 of 28 with a planned test that would fail. The 6 with gaps are FR-002, FR-005/FR-016, FR-014, FR-018, FR-027 and FR-028. SC against tasks: 5 of 5 traced, 4 of 5 demonstrated; SC-004 is not tested on the table page. Acceptance scenarios: 35 of 35 traced to a task. US-2 scenario 7 is layout and correctly has no test under testing.md section 1. Tasks with spec provenance: 28 of 28; T027's seeded long-named product traces only to sketch.md (see notes). Research claims checked against the worktree .venv (django_filters 26.2, daisy_cotton 0.1.3, mvp_forms 0.5.0, Django 6.1.2) and the daisy-cotton 0.2.0 wheel: 9 checked, 8 hold. (1) BaseFilterSet.qs drops an invalid field and keeps the others. This holds: django_filters/filterset.py:244-252 validates and then filters by form.cleaned_data (filterset.py:232); django/forms/forms.py:349-350 sends a field's ValidationError to add_error, and forms.py:315-316 deletes that field from cleaned_data. Both other sides were checked: an unbound filterset (data=None) returns queryset.all() with no validation, and a form-level clean() error deletes no field. (2) FilterView defaults filterset_fields to ALL_FIELDS and strict to True: holds (django_filters/views.py:18-19). (3) OrderingFilter is comma-separated: holds (filters.py:717, BaseCSVFilter). (4) filterset_factory: holds (filterset.py:499-510). (5) In 0.1.3, c-alert falls back to an icon named after the variant: holds (daisy_cotton/templates/cotton/alert.html, the elif variant branch). (6) The 0.2.0 c-modal holds no form, closes with type=button buttons that call close(), and names the dialog with aria-labelledby: holds. Wheel daisy_cotton-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl, sha256 13d26db0138a26caeee0b9d255161d30cde92f181c9fe8409275b5a6560ff9bc, from PyPI into the empty dir /tmp/dc020whl-gytL; templates/cotton/modal.html has no form element. (7) The 0.2.0 alert no longer picks an icon from the variant: holds (alert.html:19 in the wheel). (8) Seven package alerts rely on the variant icon: holds, 7 of 7 c-alert calls under mvp/templates. (9) list_view.js is 'loaded by list_view.html already' and is 'edited directly': does not hold (ARCH-005). New code against the tree: 13 of 13 'What already exists' lines checked; 12 hold and 1 is already provided by daisy-cotton (ARCH-003). 5 planned pieces are missing from the list (notes). Removed names (SearchMixin, OrderMixin, SearchOrderMixin, MVPFilteredListView, search_fields, max_search_words, order_by_choices, is_searchable, actions.search/sort/filter, integrations.django_filters, get_search_fields, get_order_by_choices) searched over the tree outside tests/specs/adr/CHANGELOG: 19 files, 19 of 19 in some task's Files list. In tests: 3 files, and the retirement table names their affected classes only in part (SPEC-001). Routes: the package adds none. Every existing MVPListView/MVPTableView GET route parses new query parameters and stays read-only, with the permission rule unchanged: the package applies only create-action visibility, and the consumer's view decides the rest. 2 demo routes (products/quick/, products/modal-only/) are public like /products/. There is no mutating endpoint, upload or outbound fetch. Security threat model: every new request parameter passes through the filterset form's validation. The SortFilter key is validated by ChoiceField before filter() runs, so a raw value never reaches order_by (FR-004). The search is bounded at 10 words. ModelChoiceFilter querysets may take request (plan.md passes request=), so a project can scope them. The planned widget-class mutation lands on the form's per-request deep-copied field (filterset.py:204 deepcopy of base_filters), so it cannot leak across requests. No security finding survived.

The plan's closing rule ('Any other pre-existing test that fails is a defect, not a retirement') means the Implementer either stalls at T007 or edits pre-existing tests without authority, which is blocking at S6.

But tests/test_views/test_list.py:20-26 imports SearchOrderMixin at module level, and :45 and :63 define _StubFilterView/_StubFilterViewNoSearch(SearchOrderMixin, ...), so deleting the mixin in T007 fails collection of every class in the module. In tests/test_integrations.py: TestIntegrationIsolation.test_core_views_have_no_optional_dependency_imports (~:79; it asserts core views never import django_filters, which FR-001 reverses), TestOptionalIntegrations.test_filtered_list_view_injects_applied_filters / _has_no_clear_filters_url_when_nothing_applied / _clear_filters_url_drops_only_filter_fields / test_filter_action_template_renders_clear_link_only_when_filters_applied (~:160-227, all import MVPFilteredListView), and TestTableViewActions.test_search_still_draws_when_the_view_configures_it (:477-479). The table names only test_django_filters_integration_imports from TestOptionalIntegrations.
findings.reproduction: Apply T007 (delete SearchOrderMixin) and run pytest tests/test_views/test_list.py: ImportError at collection, every class in the module errors.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the plan.md 'Tests retired' table so it names every test above with its task: T007 for the module-level stubs and the mixin-dependent classes in test_list.py, T008 for the test_integrations.py entries, and T010 for TestListPageBlocks/TestListPageToolbar. Mark which are rewritten onto a filterset rather than deleted. At least these must be rewritten, not dropped: TestListRefinements' search refinement (it becomes the FR-008 test) and TestListPageToolbar's 'toolbar stays when filters empty the list' (the spec edge case, which no new task covers).

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] When the sort is not named in toolbar_filters it sits in the modal, and the planned clear_modal_url then removes the sort's parameter, violating FR-005 (the sort MUST NOT be removed by either clear action) and FR-016.
findings.evidence: plan.md:107-110: modal_fields are 'bound fields not in the toolbar' and clear_modal_url is 'current URL without the modal fields' parameters'. Nothing excludes a SortFilter. spec.md US-1 places every field, the sort included, in the modal when toolbar_filters is empty, and US-2 scenario 4 does the same. The sketch code does exactly this: mvp/views/list.py:419-425 collects params from every modal name. T016 tests only 'keeps the toolbar's and the sort' with the sort in the toolbar. The demo's /products/modal-only/ (demo/views.py:461-464) is this case.
findings.reproduction: A view with filterset_class having a SortFilter 'o' and a ChoiceFilter 'status', and toolbar_filters=[]. Request ?o=name_asc&status=draft. The modal's clear link is the bare path, so the sort is lost.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'Placement': clear_modal_url drops the parameters of the modal's fields except a SortFilter's, using the same skip get_active_filters makes. T016 adds the case with no toolbar_filters and asserts that the sort parameter survives clear_modal_url.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] The planned formdata cleanup deletes every entry whose value is "unknown", so a search, text or choice value the reader actually chose that equals 'unknown' is silently removed from the address. FR-028 asks only that fields with no value be left out.
findings.evidence: plan.md:141: 'on the filter form's formdata, delete entries whose value is "" or "unknown" (FR-028)'. The sketch does the same: list_view.html:168-171. 'unknown' is the empty choice of Django's NullBooleanSelect only. A SearchFilter/CharFilter (kinds search and text) or a ChoiceFilter whose key is 'unknown' loses its value.
findings.reproduction: toolbar_filters=['q'] with a SearchFilter. Type 'unknown' in the search and press Enter. The address carries no q, and the list is unfiltered with no refinement.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'Behaviour in the browser': delete a "unknown" entry only when the form control it came from is a <select> (NullBooleanSelect's empty choice); keep the "" rule as it is. Extend T019's FR-028 assertion with a search for 'unknown' that reaches the address.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] FR-014 and US-2 scenario 8 require every toolbar field to carry its filter's label as its accessible name. The plan gives the 'widget' kind (a developer's own widget, such as the demo's counted Tom Select) no accessible name, so T013's 'each kind' assertion has no mechanism behind it for that kind.
findings.evidence: plan.md:94 and :103: a 'widget' field carries only `bound`, and its widget gains only daisyUI's select/input class. The sketch matches: mvp/views/list.py:48 sets only class. sketch.md round 2 records that the counted control 'shows its empty text ("Category") in place of a label', and round 3 raised it upstream as django-mvp-forms#215, still open per research.md:88-89.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'Placement': beside the class default, also setdefault the widget's aria-label to the filter's label (one line, same place). T012/T013 assert it for the widget kind.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] FR-002 says a view that still declares a removed setting MUST be refused. The plan refuses only search_fields and order_by, so a view that still sets max_search_words or overrides get_search_fields()/get_order_by_choices() is accepted silently, and its page loses search or sort with no error.
findings.evidence: plan.md:58-60 and research.md:139-142 refuse only 'a truthy search_fields or order_by'. The removed SearchMixin/OrderMixin also publish max_search_words (mvp/views/list.py:111, :133) and the override hooks get_search_fields() (:115, :135) and get_order_by_choices() (:217, :244), all documented in MVPListViewMixin's docstring (:604-605).
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'The list view and its filterset': the same __init_subclass__ check also refuses max_search_words and a class defining get_search_fields or get_order_by_choices, with one tuple of names and the same error. T007 parametrises its test over the five names.

findings.claim: [architecture] The plan reuses django-filter FilterMixin's names (filterset_class, filterset_fields, get_filterset_class, get_filterset) on MVPListViewMixin with a different signature, and says nothing about the composition the repo documents and the demo uses: MVPListViewMixin or MVPTableViewMixin plus django_filters.views.FilterView. A consumer who followed the docs gets a TypeError on every request instead of FR-002's start-up refusal. Even with a matching signature, FilterView's strict mode empties the list on an invalid value, against FR-009.
findings.evidence: docs/integrations.md:295-305 documents `class ProductTableView(MVPTableViewMixin, FilterView)`; the MVPListViewMixin docstring example (mvp/views/list.py:639-648) composes FilterView; demo/views.py:419, :762 and :775 compose it. FilterView.get (.venv django_filters/views.py) calls self.get_filterset(filterset_class), while plan.md:52 gives get_filterset() no parameter, and MRO puts MVPListViewMixin first. FilterMixin.strict = True (views.py:19) makes FilterView.get set object_list to queryset.none() on any invalid field. FilterMixin.get_filterset_kwargs passes self.get_queryset(), which in the plan returns filterset.qs, so the list is filtered twice.
findings.reproduction: class V(MVPListViewMixin, FilterView): model = Product; filterset_class = ProductFilter. GET the page: TypeError: get_filterset() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'The list view and its filterset': the same __init_subclass__ refuses a subclass that also inherits django_filters.views.FilterMixin, with ImproperlyConfigured saying the list view builds its own filterset and FilterView should be dropped. This is FR-002's refusal of the removed filtered list view, applied to its documented equivalent. T007 adds the test. T011/T025 already rewrite demo/views.py and docs/integrations.md.

findings.claim: [architecture] describe_toolbar_field(view, filterset, name) is planned as a module-level function in mvp/views/list.py that takes the view as its first argument and is called only by FilterContextMixin. Article X's Django-first rule puts it on the view, and in a published package the method is the only override point. As planned, a consumer whose filter class the table does not cover (for example a DateFilter they can draw) can only monkey-patch, because the function raises for anything else (G7).
findings.evidence: plan.md:89-91 and :101 (anything else raises). CONSTITUTION.md:95-98: 'a TemplateView method instead of a helper called by a view'. CONSTITUTION.md:84-88: a module function 'can only be monkey-patched'. The constitution-check row at plan.md:36 counts it as 'one placement function'.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'Placement': make it a FilterContextMixin method, get_toolbar_field(filterset, name), with the same body and table, documented as an override hook in T015. This is the same code moved, not new code.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] FR-027 says the package MUST NOT load any asset a developer's widget needs, yet list_view.html writes {{ filter.form.media }}, which loads a django-mvp-forms widget's own script. The plan neither keeps nor removes that line, and no task tests the 'must not'. Whether Django form media counts as 'loading an asset' is a question about the spec's meaning.
findings.evidence: mvp/templates/list_view.html:164-166 writes {{ filter.form.media }} (added by the sketch). mvp_forms/widgets.py, TomSelect.Media js = ['mvp_forms/tomselect.js'] (.venv, near widgets.py:937). sketch.md round 2 says 'The form's media has to be written on the page for the widgets' script to load', and round 3 says django-mvp no longer loads anything for Tom Select. plan.md is silent; spec.md FR-027.
findings.suggested_fix: plan.md 'Behaviour in the browser' states whether list_view.html keeps writing {{ filter.form.media }}. If it stays, record in decisions.md that a widget's own declared Media is the widget's contract and not a package asset. If Sam reads FR-027 as excluding it, that is a delta brief to spec.md, and the demo base must then load mvp_forms/tomselect.js itself.

findings.claim: [spec-compliance] FR-020: the delete page's related-objects alert takes its variant from related_objects_attrs, a dict a project replaces whole (Article XVIII). If the icon is added to the default dict, which is the obvious way to 'pass icon equal to its variant', a project using the documented override {"variant": "warning"} loses the icon it had before.
findings.evidence: mvp/templates/delete_view.html:28 `<c-alert :attrs="related_objects_attrs" only>`. mvp/views/edit.py:499 sets the default to {"variant": "info"}. edit.py:487 and docs/views.md:468 document overriding it with {"variant": "warning"}. research.md:28-31 says only 'each passes icon equal to its variant'. T001 tests only the seven alerts at their defaults.
findings.suggested_fix: research.md/T001: the related-objects alert's icon is taken in the template from related_objects_attrs.variant, unless the dict names an icon. T001's test includes a view whose related_objects_attrs is {"variant": "warning"}.

findings.claim: [architecture] Rebuilding c-mvp.modal with its card inside daisy-cotton 0.2.0's c-modal does not give the dialog a name as research.md claims. c-modal sets aria-labelledby only when it is given a title, and it then draws its own <h2> in the box, beside the card's own heading, which has no id. T002's 'the dialog is named by its title' has no mechanism.
findings.evidence: 0.2.0 wheel templates/cotton/modal.html: `{% if id and title %}aria-labelledby="{{ id }}-title"{% endif %}` and `{% if title %}<h2 id="{{ id }}-title" ...>`. mvp/templates/cotton/mvp/card/index.html:18 draws `<h2 class="card-title">` with no id. c-mvp.modal declares no title prop; a title reaches the card through attrs (cotton/mvp/modal.html:12, :17). research.md:20-24.
findings.suggested_fix: research.md and T002: c-mvp.modal never passes title to c-modal. It passes aria-label equal to the title it forwards to the card, through c-modal's attrs. T002 asserts the dialog's accessible name and that it has a single heading.
